verdict.rationale: v0's docs explicitly describe scaffolding full-stack apps from prompts, connecting to databases/backends, and one-click deployment (v0-docs-15, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-28, v0-docs-35, v0-docs-32), and a first-party SDK example shows creating an app from a single natural-language message (v0-gh-1). A community report corroborates building a full working MVP (auth, roles, export) end-to-end via v0 (v0-comm-1), though other community feedback notes cost concerns and generic design output (v0-comm-3, v0-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent verification of complex, production-grade full-stack apps beyond simple demos, and more diverse hands-on case studies.
